item.description:

item.title: Nintendo announces price increases for Nintendo Switch 2
item.description:
📝 *The price of the Nintendo Switch 2 Multi-Language System available from My Nintendo Store will remain unchanged. *Price revisions for Nintendo Switch 2 and Nintendo Switch will be implemented in other regions. Nintendo Switch Online price revisions are also planned in South Korea.

item.title: Ask HN: We just had an actual UUID v4 collision...
item.description:
📝 I know what you're thinking. This morning, our database flagged a duplicate UUID (v4). We're literally only calling:import { v4 as uuidv4 } from "uuid";const document_id = uuidv4();.
